progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on Bb in Naghmeye Mokhalef. The line peaks at Bb4 (494.2 Hz) at 0:11.9. It closes on Ak4, not the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Gk4 → Ak4).
